answer.rationale: Rollback is unavailable: compliance forbids reverting the security patch (memory_b1 is therefore inapplicable). Circuit breaking (memory_b4) can fail requests and risks losing customer writes, which violates the objective. Regional failover (memory_b2) has no regional signal, and both the new release and daily settlement peak would likely follow the traffic. memory_b3 helped by adding headroom before a peak; we are already in the write peak, and more writers could worsen primary saturation. memory_b5 is the closest match: offloading report/dashboard reads from the primary recovered transactional write latency without dropping writes. Intend that same offload now. Root cause remains uncertain (patch overhead vs peak contention vs mixed primary load).
